# FEB Digi — Web Design and Development Studio

> FEB designs and builds fast, conversion-focused websites and scalable web platforms for businesses.

## Main pages

- [Homepage](https://febdigi.com/): Overview of FEB, services, process, selected projects, and contact options.
- [Selected projects](https://febdigi.com/#work): Websites and web platforms delivered by FEB.
- [Services](https://febdigi.com/#services): Business websites, e-commerce solutions, custom web applications, and booking systems.
- [Process](https://febdigi.com/#process): FEB's proposal, wireframe, design, and development workflow.
- [Blog](https://febdigi.com/#blog): Articles and practical insights about websites and digital growth.
- [Contact FEB](https://febdigi.com/#contact): Start a website or web-platform project with FEB.

## Languages

The website is available in English and Vietnamese. The language switcher in the header changes the visible page content.

## Crawling resources

- [XML sitemap](https://febdigi.com/sitemap.xml)
- [Robots policy](https://febdigi.com/robots.txt)

## Usage guidance

Public website content may be crawled for search, discovery, citation, and answering questions about FEB's services. Project images and brand assets remain the property of FEB or their respective owners.
